Dear Amelia Oakley,

Regarding your report of the front door lock at Flat 23, 155 Willowmere Road being hard to turn: our records show the contractor attended on 17 and 18 November, but we have not yet received his written job result for your address.

Could you please confirm two things: (1) whether the lock now locks and unlocks normally, and (2) whether you were given a new key and have a working set. If the lock is still stiff, please tell us and do not force the key.

We have asked the contractor for his report and invoice and have passed the file to a property manager for review. We will come back to you once we have his reply; we are not booking a further visit until we know whether one is needed.
